title: Yom Kippur War
summary: Egypt and Syria attacked Israel on two fronts on the Jewish holy day of Yom Kippur, 1973. After early Arab gains, Israel crossed the Suez Canal and pushed back the Syrians. The fighting ended with a cease-fire on October 26, drew in the US and Soviet Union indirectly, and paved the way for Egypt–Israel peace.
